parsed.answer: This has been reported before. Opening the file picker from the Browse button in the profile Command line setting can freeze Windows Terminal, and in terminal#9984 the freeze happens specifically when you edit the path in the address bar, which matches your Backspace case. The freeze happens on Windows 10 (you are on build 19045). The maintainers suspect it is a Windows 10 file dialog issue outside Terminal's control and that it may be fixed in Windows 11 (terminal#12199). The tickets give no fix. As a workaround, don't use Browse: type or paste the executable path directly into the Command line field, which still works, or edit settings.json by hand (terminal#9984). If Terminal is already frozen, end the task in Task Manager, which causes no side effects. Some reports say the dialog may eventually return after a long wait, but this is not reliable (terminal#17979). Upgrading to Windows 11 may avoid the problem.
